# CBA Suites Madeira

> Studios and suites from 32 to 78 m² with kitchenettes, balconies over Funchal bay and an outdoor pool. 8 minutes' walk to the Casino, 16 to the Cathedral. Rated 8.4 on Booking.com.

CBA Suites Madeira is a small boutique aparthotel (Alojamento Local licence 107149/AL) at Calçada da Caboqueira 54, São Pedro, 9000-900 Funchal, Madeira, Portugal (32.648275, -16.918311; Plus Code J3XJ+8M). It is managed by Madeira Luxury Villas. The site is available in English, Ukrainian, Portuguese, German, French, Polish, and Russian.

## Key facts
- Outdoor swimming pool open all year, in a garden walled with Madeiran basalt; sun terrace and sunbeds.
- Every studio and suite has a kitchenette (stovetop, microwave, fridge, kettle, dishwasher) and a dining table.
- Lounge with billiards, books and board games; free coffee and tea 24 hours; free Wi-Fi (guest score 9.1).
- Self check-in 15:00–00:30 with a door code; check-out by 10:30. Lift to all floors.
- Adults only (minimum age 18). No pets, no smoking, no parties or group bookings. Quiet hours 22:00–10:00.
- Paid airport transfer on request. Madeira Airport (FNC) is 20 km away, about 25 minutes by car.
- Ratings (November 2026): Booking.com 8.4/10 from 945 reviews; Google 4.3/5 from 117 reviews.

## Suites
- **Deluxe with Balcony · loft**: 78 m², up to 4 guests, 2 extra-large double beds and a sofa bed. The largest suite, on two levels. The living room opens onto a balcony and terrace, and the stairs lead up to a bedroom under the roof with a skylight over the bay.
- **Superior Suite with Sea View**: 45 m², up to 4 guests, 1 extra-large double bed and a sofa bed. Floor-to-ceiling glass and a balcony looking across Funchal bay, with an outdoor dining table. The photo at the top of this page was taken here.
- **Deluxe Suite with Sea View**: 56 m², up to 4 guests, 1 extra-large double bed and a sofa bed. A big living and dining room with windows towards the sea and the pool, and a separate bedroom.
- **King Suite with Balcony**: 43 m², up to 4 guests, 1 extra-large double bed and a sofa bed. A king-size bedroom that looks down onto the pool, and a living room with a balcony and terrace.
- **Queen Suite**: 56 m², up to 3 guests, 1 large double bed and a sofa bed. A wide living room with a panoramic window over the city and the bay, a balcony and a separate bedroom.
- **Deluxe Suite**: 56 m², up to 4 guests, 1 extra-large double bed and a sofa bed. A spacious suite with a separate bedroom, a sofa bed in the living room and views of the sea and the city.
- **Suite with City View**: 34 m², up to 3 guests, 1 double bed and a sofa bed. A compact suite with a separate bedroom and a living room looking over the rooftops to the Fortaleza do Pico. From €90 a night.
- **Studio**: 32 m², up to 2 guests, 1 large double bed. A bright open-plan studio with a kitchenette, a dining table and a door onto a small terrace. From €75 a night.

## Island tours and drive times from the house
- Pico do Arieiro: Sunrise above the clouds at 1,818 m, and the start of the PR1 ridge path to Pico Ruivo. (about 35 min by car)
- Monte and the toboggans: Monte Palace gardens, the church of Our Lady of Monte and the wicker-sledge ride back down. (about 10 min by car)
- Botanical Garden: Terraces of plants from five continents above Funchal, linked to Monte by a second cable car. (about 10 min by car)
- Cabo Girão skywalk: A glass floor 580 m above the sea on one of Europe's highest cliffs. (about 20 min by car)
- Câmara de Lobos: The fishing village Churchill came to paint, with bright boats and poncha bars. (about 15 min by car)
- Nuns' Valley: A village deep inside a ring of mountains, seen from the Eira do Serrado viewpoint. (about 25 min by car)
- Balcões levada: An easy 1.5 km walk along a water channel to a lookout over the Ribeiro Frio valley. (about 30 min by car)
- Caldeirão Verde: A levada through laurel forest and tunnels to a waterfall in a green cauldron. (about 65 min by car)
- Fanal forest: Centuries-old laurels in the mist on the Paul da Serra plateau. (about 60 min by car)
- Porto Moniz pools: Natural seawater pools in black lava rock on the north-west tip of the island. (about 65 min by car)
- Seixal beach: Black volcanic sand under green cliffs on the north coast. (about 55 min by car)
- Véu da Noiva: The Bridal Veil waterfall, dropping off the cliff straight into the sea. (about 50 min by car)
- Santana: Triangular thatched houses and terraced fields on the green north coast. (about 50 min by car)
- Ponta de São Lourenço: The bare red and ochre eastern cape, walked on the PR8 trail. (about 40 min by car)
- Ponta do Sol: A sunny south-coast town with a small beach and a pier for the sunset. (about 30 min by car)
- Dolphins and whales: Boat trips from Funchal marina. Dolphins are seen all year round. (boats leave from Funchal marina, 15 min walk)
- Desertas Islands: A full-day sail to the nature reserve where monk seals live. (boats leave from Funchal marina, 15 min walk)
- Porto Santo: Nine kilometres of golden sand on the neighbouring island, about 2 h 15 min by ferry. (ferry from Funchal port)

## FAQ
**What time are check-in and check-out?** Check-in is from 15:00 to 00:30 and check-out by 10:30. Tell us your arrival time in advance and you'll receive a door code for self check-in.

**Is the pool open all year?** Yes. The outdoor pool is open all year round, with sunbeds on the deck and the garden around it.

**How far is the centre of Funchal?** The Casino is 600 m (8 min on foot), the marina 1.1 km (15 min) and the Sé Cathedral 1.2 km (16 min). The Plaza Madeira shopping centre with a Pingo Doce supermarket is 8 minutes away.

**Do the suites have a kitchen?** Yes. Every studio and suite has a kitchenette with a stovetop, microwave, fridge, kettle and dishwasher, plus a dining table.

**How do I get here from the airport?** Cristiano Ronaldo Madeira Airport (FNC) is 20 km away, about 25 minutes by car. A paid transfer can be arranged on request; taxis and airport buses also run to the centre.

**Is there parking?** There is street parking around the house, though spaces aren't always free, and a public car park at Plaza Madeira, 8 minutes' walk away.

**Can I book island tours from here?** Yes. Most tours, from levada walks to the Pico do Arieiro sunrise and jeep trips, pick up guests in central Funchal. Dolphin and whale-watching boats leave from the marina, 15 minutes' walk away.

**Can children stay?** CBA Suites is for adults: the minimum age is 18, and cots and extra beds aren't available.

**Are pets allowed?** Pets aren't allowed.

**Is there Wi-Fi?** Free Wi-Fi works throughout the house. Guests rate it 9.1 out of 10.

**Are parties or group bookings accepted?** No. Quiet hours run from 22:00 to 10:00, and the house doesn't take group bookings or stag and hen parties.

**Which languages does the staff speak?** English and Spanish.
